Class Controller

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.controller.Controller
All Implemented Interfaces:
ControllerInterface, Serializable
public class Controller extends Object implements ControllerInterface, Serializable
This controller class represents the server-side object bound to each connected client. It implements ControllerInterface and handles communication between a specific player and the game logic managed by the MultiGameController and GameController.

Each player has their own instance of this class, which acts as a proxy for game operations. It is also responsible for delegating commands and state updates to the appropriate controller and view components.
